sentences.en: The boy crushed the spider with his sandaled right foot.
sentences.zh: 男孩用穿着凉鞋的右脚踩死了那只蜘蛛。

sentences.en: How many pairs of sandals do you make per month?
sentences.zh: 你每个月做多少双凉鞋？

sentences.en: Look at that fashion criminal wearing socks with sandals.
sentences.zh: 看看那个时尚罪犯，穿着袜子和凉鞋。

senses.zh: 凉鞋，草带鞋,植檀香木v.使穿上凉鞋
